cells.gaps: No named decision on a controller and no published count of decisions, sanctions or complaints settled for a stated year; the 2022 control operations (CIV-004) have no count or sanction. CIV-003 does not say in terms that the law is in force, but CIV-009 treats it as operating.
cells.note: Law 2013-450 is in force with Decree 2015-79 issued and ARTCI designated by the decree and acting in 2026 (Certinum), but every application fact is activity, so stage 4 is not met. Authority is constituted, so no cap applies.
